title: [review] project-LICHEN-2auf.44.11.1.1: EdhocResponder has duplicate constructor signatures (new and new_with_rng)
description:
`EdhocResponder` has two public constructors with identical signatures:
```rust
pub fn new<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(seed: [u8; 32], c_r: u8, rng: &mut R) -> Self
pub fn new_with_rng<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(seed: [u8; 32], c_r: u8, rng: &mut R) -> Result<Self, OscoreError>
```

Both take `(seed, c_r, rng)` but `new` uses `StaticSecret::random_from_rng(rng)` while `new_with_rng` derives the ephemeral key from seed via `rng.try_fill_bytes`. Having two constructors with identical parameter lists but different return types and key derivation strategies is confusing and an API maintenance hazard. Callers cannot distinguish them by type signature alone.

Fix: eliminate one constructor (likely `new_with_rng`) or differentiate their signatures (e.g., make `new` the simple convenience that wraps `new_with_rng` and returns `Result`, matching the initiator pattern).
